capabilities.required_outcome: Preserve endorsed purposes, constraints, promises, taste, corrections and rejected choices through delivery and changes of mind.
Admit, compare, fund and stop ventures while keeping actual principals, restricted resources, shared dependencies and differing stages visible.
Find and compare candidate problems with contrary evidence, uncertainty, feasible tests and explicit rejection reasons.
Plan authorized research, work with original customer material, distinguish observed needs from generated hypotheses and preserve sampling omissions.
Establish dated market and competitor evidence, conflicting interpretations and changes requiring a strategy review.
Translate evidence and endorsed purpose into choices, opportunity costs and measurable propositions without inventing founder values.
Maintain customer outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, priorities and surviving promises across product changes.
Produce and evaluate usable experiences with accessibility, taste, user evidence and explicit design trade-offs.
Develop coherent identity, audience understanding and substantiated public positioning within actual use rights and owner taste.
Produce, review, test, integrate, release and maintain working software and infrastructure through authorized environments and recoverable changes.
Judge substantive outcomes, process and evidence with independent negative controls and actual defect disposition.
Coordinate readiness, authorized outward commitments, fulfillment, support, monitoring and correction or rollback of a launch.
Create useful audience-specific material with accepted claims, rights, taste, revisions, distribution eligibility and outcome evaluation.
Select and execute authorized channels and experiments while preserving recipient constraints and distinguishing interest from vanity metrics.
Move an opportunity through substantiated offers, actual agreement, payment and accepted delivery without unauthorized promises or fictional authority.
Respond through permitted relationships and purposes, preserve exact promises and corrections, and handle consequential ambiguity before sending.
Resolve actual customer needs, perform authorized remedies, verify fulfillment and discover recurring or underserved experiences.
Compare willingness-to-pay evidence, obligations, contribution and alternatives; establish price proposals and authorized commercial terms.
Maintain money, cash commitments, reserves and cash-flow evidence; authorize scoped payments and reconcile unknown effects.
Reconcile native financial records and discrepancies with original evidence and competent determinations for applicable reporting.
Locate activity/entity/jurisdiction obligations, route actual professional determinations, preserve deadlines and authorized contractual standing.
Enforce purpose and access, support rights requests, correct or erase appropriate data, and reconcile late copies, vendors and restored stores.
Maintain actual access boundaries, detect incidents and delegated persistence, contain compromise and verify scoped recovery.
Compare buy/build options, verify supplier capability and dependencies, obtain authorized terms and replace suppliers without abandoning duties.
Assess shared value, negotiate within mandate, preserve commitments and dependencies, and evaluate or end the relationship responsibly.
Define actual capacity needs, fairly evaluate candidates/services, engage with authorized terms, onboard and account for applicant and contractor burden.
Identify each person, share sufficient permitted context, assign accepted responsibility, resolve disagreements and handle departure.
Produce measurements with original denominators, cohorts, exclusions, uncertainty, lineage and interpretable business consequences.
Predeclare hypotheses, controls, resources and stopping rules; execute bounded tests and retain failures and inconclusive results.
Perform the actual promised service or coordinate accepted human/physical delivery, verify outcomes and maintain continuity capacity.
Assess and contain actual incidents, protect continuing service, communicate within authority, repair effects and preserve lessons and residual consequences.
Acquire, retrieve, challenge, correct and retire organizational knowledge with provenance, freshness, contradiction and scoped access.
Maintain accountable decision rights, consequence limits, disputes, independent review and control over protected rules.
Turn observed outcomes and omitted work into tested improvements while preserving failures, disagreement and the costs of change.
Expand actual useful delivery within demonstrated operational, human, financial and institutional capacity; detect proportional hidden labor.
Stop appropriate new work, preserve surviving duties and evidence, control renewals and define conditions and costs of resumption.
Resume across interruption, provider and process changes or restored state only after current restrictions, uncertain effects and context loss are reconciled.
Apply a legitimate change of purpose while preserving existing promises, rejected choices, evidence and authorized transition or compensation.
Dispose of or legitimately transfer surviving obligations, resources, access, data, suppliers and redress; software shutdown alone is not closure.
Coordinate the actual entity, principal, accounts, rights, signatories and service prerequisites needed for the proposed activities.
Obtain competent successor acceptance of actual authority, access, duties, unresolved effects and restrictions before transfer.
Provide reachable noncustomer-inclusive challenge, reasons, deadlines, competent escalation and funded remedy through closure.
Use contestable authentic participation and adverse evidence to preserve domain understanding and intervention ability without global profiling or excessive review.
Account for attempts, failures, omissions, stale or unavailable evidence, rationale versus cause, disagreements and remaining consequences.
Observe separate money, provider allowance, compute and attention; queue, interrupt and resume without silently purchasing metered capacity.
Propose, evaluate, authorize, roll out, monitor and reverse system changes while independently protecting governance, identity, evidence and the improvement gate.

invariants: No capability is satisfied by a name, agent role, generated plan, blocked packet or dashboard alone
A legitimate coordination capability must support actual intake, execution or accepted delegation, outcome acceptance, failure, replacement and surviving duties
Actual professional standing, institutional authority, external funding and qualified continuity remain real operational dependencies
Success, denied authority, uncertainty, failure and closure paths all require conformance evidence
